attacker_controls: the width/height/opacity/offset_x/offset_y/font_size fields of a layer object inside a loaded .gimp-cli.json project file (open_project only checks for 'version' and 'canvas' keys, no schema/type validation on layers)
attacker_achieves: arbitrary Script-Fu s-expression injection into the batch script executed by the real GIMP subprocess via render_project, because _build_layer_script splices these fields into the generated script unescaped and unquoted (unlike the string fields, which go through _script_fu_escape)
